name: forward-interleaving-canonical
description: One replica inserts 'a' then 'b' left to right; another concurrently inserts 'x' at the same position. The canonical forward anomaly.

expected.rationale: Forward non-interleaving: 'ab' must stay contiguous. 'axb' is the anomaly defined in arXiv A.1 preamble; Table 1 proves Fugue avoids it (forward, one replica).
